MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 218, Comm. William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Joshua D. White, Esq. appeared for plaintiff David Garrison, as Successor-In-Interest to Jane Garrison and Howard Garrison, and as Trustee of the Garrison Family Trust.
No appearance by defendant Troy L. Bartz.
Default was entered against defendant on November 16, 2009.
Doe defendants were dismissed on February 25, 2010.

After hearing the evidence presented, and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of Plaintiff David Garrison, as Successor-In-Interest to Jane Garrison and Howard Garrison, and as Trustee of the Garrison Family Trust, and against the Defaulted Defendant Troy L. Bartz as follows:

Damages/Principal - $473,836.00, for a total judgment in the amount of $473,836.00.

Judgment was submitted to and signed by the Court.
